notes.title: Fenrir's Prelude Remake Official Release
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Thank you for your patience. This is almost the 3 year anniversary since Fenrir's Prelude has been released in 2021.

I am really excited for everyone to enjoy this version. There might still be some issues but most have been patched. Don't worry I will still update Fenrir's Prelude from time to time because I do have some newer content that I do have planned.

Again, thank you for your patience and support. It means the world to me!

Now, I will begin working on the Fated Zodiac game which will come in chapters please follow me on social media to stay updated.

Twitter: BasedRagnarok
All other Socials: RagnarokAesthetic

With love,
Ragnarok Aesthetic

notes.title: Fenrir's Prelude Remake Beta is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Thank you for your patience. Fenrir's Prelude remake has finally released the beta testing phase.
If you would like to enter the beta please right click the game, properties, select betas and enter
[i][b]Ragnarok2024[/b][/i] after this you will be added to the beta test. In the top right hand corner there will be a new drop down in the betas menu. Please opt into it and play the game. This game is a full version but there are still bugs and things that will be added later on. Please report any errors or bugs to the big discussion board.

Stay tuned!
Ragnarok Aesthetic

notes.title: Fenrir's Prelude Updates and Feedback
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Hope all is well with everyone!

Currently I am working on more updates for Fenrir's Prelude.
I will be patching bugs, adding new features, and a new ending.
I would like to hear feedback from that will go towards the upcoming overhaul updates:


[list]
[*]What did you like about the game?
[*]What would you like to see in the game?
[*]What lore would you like to learn about?
[*]What did you dislike about the game?
[*]What changes would you like to see?
[/list]

Please feel free to respond here or head over to the discussion board and fill me in with the following information and more.

Thank you for the support,
Ragnarok Aesthetic
